title: Flicker the regime around the zero threshold
teach: Regime is a strict sign test on net flow with no deadband, so alternating dust either side of zero flips which vault the epoch would fund on every single swap. Nothing breaks, but the switch has no hysteresis.

expect.notesYellow: The regime flipped on every swap. Zero is the only threshold, so dust either side of it moves which vault an epoch would fund.
